name: Visigothic Kingdom
description: The Visigothic Kingdom emerges in Spain after the fall of the Western Roman Empire.

name: Muslim Conquest
description: Muslim armies invade and conquer Spain.

name: Reconquista
description: The Christian kingdoms gradually recapture territory from Muslim rule.

name: Alhambra Decree
description: Spanish monarchs issue the Alhambra Decree, expelling Jews from Spain.

name: Spanish Empire
description: Spain becomes a leading global power with vast colonial holdings.

name: Spanish Golden Age
description: Spain experiences a cultural flourishing in art, literature, and exploration.

name: Peninsular War
description: Spain fights against French occupation during the Napoleonic era.

name: Spanish Civil War
description: A brutal conflict between Republicans and Nationalists that leads to the rise of Francisco Franco.

name: Francisco Franco Dictatorship
description: General Franco rules Spain as a dictator until his death.

name: Spanish Transition to Democracy
description: Spain transitions from Franco's dictatorship to a constitutional monarchy.
